sam k: Heads-up — starting in 5. If you're on stage for the demo, please be on standby with the demo laptop and HDMI. Stream/recording check in progress.
maya: I see captions not appearing in the staging stream. Anyone else? :eyes:
ops-bot: Recording started (rec_2491004321). Stream ingest OK, bitrate stable ~4.2 Mbps.
tara: Demo laptop reporting black screen when switching apps. Jeff can you remote in?
jeff: On it. Maya, can you toggle captions source? In OBS it's set to `live_transcript_v2`.
maya: Toggled. Captions popped for ~10s then went blank.
derek: Re-route plan: if captions fail, we'll switch to the manual captioning channel (captioners@redwood) and enable SRT overlay. /cc @tara
tara: Jeff, I gave you access. Running `xrandr --output HDMI1 --auto` on the demo laptop as quick patch.
jeff: Patch applied, black screen cleared. Demo app_resize likely caused the freeze.
sam k: Great. Can we confirm recording has clean audio? I heard a low hum earlier.
ops-bot: Audio levels: left -0.8dB, right -1.1dB. Noise floor elevated by ~6dB compared to baseline.
maya: Hum is gone after switching to backup mixer channel. :thumbsup:
sam k: OK proceeding. During Q&A, if leadership gets asked about timeline for Project X, reply with: "targeting H2, exact launch dependent on Dedicated perf signoff — will follow up." Keep answers short.
jeff: Also leaving one action item: post the demo recording link + caption transcript to #all-hands within 4 hours. I'll upload.
tara: Noted. I'll ping captioners for manual transcript if auto doesn't recover.
sam k: Thanks everyone. After meeting, drop follow-ups in this thread. Also legal asked about recording retention — here's the policy link: https://intranet/redwood/policy/recording-retention
maya: Adding: can we get a short bullet in the follow-up about the perf benchmark baseline used? Leadership asked for the snapshot id.
derek: I'll export the perf snapshot id and drop it here after the meeting.
